text_block_list.text:
I head up to the rooftop for some fresh
air and
find Gold Ship and Grass
Wonder standing there.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
No...
I'm still lacking something I need as Uma
Lord! I must go on a voyage to find
the missing
piece!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
A voyage does sounds lovely, buuut...
not today,
I think.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Everyone promised to have a race at the
training
track, remember?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Ah, of course. You mean to say that
"time is of
the essence," yes?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
But do your best! And even if you miss
me, shed
no tears! For we shall meet
again someday!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Honestly,
that Golshi. I'd better get
a move
on and bring her back.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Oh, that would be very kind of you.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
In that case, bring her back here if you
find her. I
appreciate the help.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Golshi's set off on a voyage?! Rayos! But
what
about today's race?!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
We must locate and capture la fugitiva!
She's not
getting away on my watch!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Golshi's on a voyage?!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I bet she's trying to run away from racing
me! I'll
find her if it's the last thing I do!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Nah, haven't seen her. Come to think of
it, didn't
everyone promise to race
today?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Okie-dokie. You betcha. I'll look for her
on my
way back to the academy.

I search high and low for Gold Ship, but
with no
sign of her, I return to the
rooftop to find...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hehehehe... Someday, this whole world
will
belong to Uma Lord Golshi!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: We finally found ya!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Ugh! Do you have any idea how long
we've been
looking for you?!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! So this is where you were. No
wonder we
couldn't find you.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Phew... Great work, everyone.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Guess ya found me... Heh. I s'pose they
do say
that a criminal always returns to
the scene o' the
crime.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I've been watching y'all from up here on
my perch.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
And it's helped me realize what I, Uma
Lord
Golshi, have been missing—what I
really need.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Four Umamusume have come here in
search of
yours truly... I assume you
know what I'm getting
at, right?

Gold Ship's face is absolutely serious as
she waits
for an answer.

The Uma Lord and four Umamusume.
Hearing
that, the first thing that comes
to mind is...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I knew you had it in you, dear Watson! You
should be part of the Four—wait,
it's the Four
Paladins, not the
More-Than-Four Paladins!
choice_data_list: I don't have the slightest clue...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Tell ya what, then—you be the hero!
And if you
beat me, I'll give you half the
world!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
No more talking! To battle! C'mon!
Gimme yer
best shot!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
But you've gotta battle us first!
GOTCHA!

El Condor Pasa and King Halo grab Gold
Ship by
the arms and drag her away.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha! And now you get whisked
away like a
cow caught in a tractor
beam.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I've got it! Why don't we build castles
for the Four
Paladins in space?! We can
fill them with booby
traps!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Why don't we all go running together
first? That
way we can strengthen the
bonds of the Four
Paladins too.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Siiigh... Just don't cause any trouble, okay?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I want a wrestling ring in my castillo!
And
make
sure my doorbell's a gong!

The Uma Lord may be chaos incarnate,
but she appears to have a good
relationship with the Four
Paladins
nonetheless.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
That's right! In service of Uma Lord
Golshi are the
unstoppable Four
Paladins!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
El the Habanero! Sky the Fisher-uma!
Grass the
Beast! The other one!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Why am I just the "other one"?!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
If you're gonna give me a ring name,
then I want
something cooler, por favor!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, I think I'm fine with mine. That
title sounds
like permission to sit back
and do some angling.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Dear me... It looks like I may be the only
one with
a moniker fit for fighting.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
We've got the Uma Lord and the Four
Paladins,
so now we need a hero.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Oh! I'll also need someone to tearfully
betray the heroes, and a despicable
advisor who's trying to
take over the
country!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Geez, there really is no rest for the Uma
Lord!

And so, having found her Four Paladins,
the Uma
Lord's journey continues.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
You buffoon! There's only one thing that
could bring so many unique individuals
together—and that's hot pot! Imagine us,
a right old gaggle of witches, workin' our
dark magic 'round the cauldron!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Don't look for reason or logic in
anything this one
says or does...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I've got the munchies somethin' fierce
now, but I haven't got a cauldron... What
about a clay pot?
We can at least scrape
together some clay, right?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
You guys, go out hunting for
ingredients! Get us some edible stuff,
some inedible stuff, whatever
tickles
your fancy!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I'm heading out to find some clay for the
pot!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Guess I'll do some fishing, then...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Wait! It's still too early for dinner. We
should
really prepare for the race first.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Absolutamente! I'm hankering for hot
pot too,
but I've been really looking
forward to this race!

In the end, Gold Ship gets dragged
away by her
friends...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hot pooooot! Hey, you there! Get that
hot pot
ready! Make sure there's enough
to feed all of us!

She does as she pleases, going wherever
the wind
takes her, without a care in the
world.

And that's probably where Gold Ship's
charm lies.
